data.title: 巴泽特·弗拉加·马克雷米兹 · 写下符文的纸
data.description: 她把一张写满记录的纸放在桌上，正用笔补上最后一个符文。
data.action: writing a rune on a sheet of paper at a desk
data.promptProse: At an unadorned wooden desk inside a secure safehouse room, Bazett draws an intricate Norse rune with black ink on a sheet of heavy parchment, channeling subtle magical prana. A single desk lamp casts hard shadows over scattered runic reference scrolls, a ceramic mug of strong black tea, and her intense, arcane concentration.
